label: Bible Study
prompt: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no _____; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
verse: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
note: Three men thrown into the furnace, four men walking around in it — and not even the smell of smoke on them afterward.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou art my _____ place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verse: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
note: God as a hiding place who surrounds David with songs of deliverance — a shelter with a soundtrack.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the _____ that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verse: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
note: John received his Revelation in exile on the isle called Patmos, 'for the word of God.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither _____ nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verse: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
note: Right after 'baptized into Christ': ethnic, social and gender lines don't rank anyone in God's family.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The _____ of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verse: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
note: Keep the true fast and you shall be called 'The repairer of the breach' — a rebuilder of broken walls and paths.
